scenario: A marketplace operations manager audits a seller's existing product reviews to assess authenticity and sentiment quality, runs NLP analysis on the review text to produce a content-quality index, and then uses both metrics to determine an appropriate price tier before publishing or updating the product listing on Clawver.
info_flow: clawver-reviews fetches the product's reviews and computes a review quality score from rating distribution and sentiment → nlp-toolkit analyzes review body text to produce a content authenticity index (perplexity/burstiness metrics) → clawver-digital-products uses the combined quality score and authenticity index to select a price tier and publish the listing.
